Accumulates transaction rebate totals and per-account rebates, then reports or clears them.

# Purpose
This C file implements the rebate accumulation logic for `fd_pack`. It defines and initializes an internal hash map named `rmap` that tracks rebate amounts per account address, and it stores running totals for cost rebates, vote rebates, data-byte rebates, microblock-count rebates, and initializer-bundle result state. The [`fd_pack_rebate_sum_new`](<#fd_pack_rebate_sum_new>) function clears the state and creates the map, while [`fd_pack_rebate_sum_clear`](<#fd_pack_rebate_sum_clear>) resets the accumulator and removes all stored account entries.

The main work happens in [`fd_pack_rebate_sum_add_txn`](<#fd_pack_rebate_sum_add_txn>), which processes a set of transactions and their additional writable account addresses. For each transaction, it updates the global rebate totals and adds the transaction rebate to each writable account entry in the map. It also handles bundle and initializer-bundle flags, counts microblock rebates, and tracks whether the bundle succeeded. The [`fd_pack_rebate_sum_report`](<#fd_pack_rebate_sum_report>) function copies the accumulated totals and per-account rebate entries into an output `fd_pack_rebate_t` structure, then clears the internal state for the reported entries.
